column1: # PostgreSQL-style SQL prototype: the values corpus (fork issue #29), the writes of jsonb, arrays and bytea.

# The columns and the rules are those of writes.tsv: id, status, checks, statement, expected. Every case runs in a transaction that is rolled back, on the table of values-schema.sql (the server) and of ValuesFixture (ArcadeDB).
# expected: written by the generator from the real server, never by hand. pending-server = the generator has not run on the case yet.

# Not here, because a record cannot hold them as PostgreSQL does (refused with 0A000, tested in ValuesWriteTest): a JSON value that is not what the property holds, a null element of a typed list, an array of more than one dimension. vector needs pgvector, which this server does not have.
# server: PostgreSQL 18.7 (Debian 18.7-1.pgdg13+5) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit
